title: SAR and InSAR Change Detection with Quantum Generative Models
summary: Change detection in synthetic aperture radar (SAR) and interferometric synthetic aperture radar (InSAR) underpins disaster response, infrastructure monitoring and land-use enforcement. Detection is limited by the background estimator, which conventionally forms a conditional expectation directly from observed pixel statistics and degrades where those statistics are sparse, including the regime produced by the heavy-tailed marginals of sub-meter-resolution radars.
